blocks.title: Spam
blocks.text: Spam email ya phone par aane wale ghair matloob paigham hain.

Anjaan numbers se SMS aisi cheezein, jaali inaam ya saste qarz pesh kar sakte hain jo aap ne kabhi nahi maange. Yeh waqt zaya karte aur zaati maloomat ya paise dene par aamada karne ki koshish kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Jis inaam mein aap ne hissa hi nahi liya us ke SMS ka jawab kyun nahi dena chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Yeh ghaliban spam ya dhoka hai jo aap ki tafseel ya paise chahta hai; jawab dene se yeh bhi tasdeeq hoti hai ke number chalu hai.

items: Spam: ghair matloob paigham (jaali inaam, qarz) jo waqt zaya karte aur dhoka ho sakte hain.
